title: Bag Filling with Additional Rocks
problemStatement: There are N bags, each with a capacity and an initial number of rocks. You are given additional rocks that may be distributed arbitrarily. Determine the maximum number of bags that can become completely full.
input: • First line contains integers N and AdditionalRocks. • Second line contains N integers representing capacities. • Third line contains N integers representing current rocks.
output: Print the maximum number of completely filled bags.
